rob-lewis.name: Rob Lewis
rob-lewis.bio: Rob is a senior business writer at Urban Observer, with more than 10 years of financial and market reporting experience. Passionate and detail oriented, he has a proven track record of reliability and fairness that sets him apart from others. Always looking for the next big story!

ava-chen.name: Ava Chen
ava-chen.bio: Ava covers technology and consumer devices for Urban Observer, translating complex product launches and industry shifts into stories anyone can follow. She has a background in software engineering and a soft spot for anything with a good UI.

daniel-brooks.name: Daniel Brooks
daniel-brooks.bio: Daniel is Urban Observer's politics correspondent, covering elections, policy, and the people shaping public life. He's spent over a decade reporting from statehouses and campaign trails, and believes good political writing should be clear, not clever.

maria-torres.name: Maria Torres
maria-torres.bio: Maria leads investigative reporting at Urban Observer, digging into fraud, corporate accountability, and stories that take months to unravel. She previously worked in data journalism and has a habit of reading contracts for fun.

james-carter.name: James Carter
james-carter.bio: James writes about health, wellness, and the science behind everyday habits for Urban Observer. A former public health researcher, he's committed to separating solid evidence from wellness-industry noise.

sophie-nolan.name: Sophie Nolan
sophie-nolan.bio: Sophie covers sports for Urban Observer, from major league business to grassroots athletics. A former collegiate athlete herself, she's especially drawn to stories about what happens off the field.
